title: Context
description: The correlation of an event: the W3C Trace Context identifiers and the ids of the execution and of the correlation. High-cardinality ids such as execution_id are never metric attributes (REQ-CTR-006).

trace_id.description: W3C trace id: 32 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

span_id.description: W3C span id: 16 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

execution_id.description: The execution this event belongs to.

correlation_id.description: A correlation id given by the consumer.
